report: Read all 13 verses end to end against the candidate table and the dump. Every multi-treatment bucket is context-licensed: הַ is *the* where the ASV writes it (76.0), unrepresented where it writes none (76.9, before *judgment*), and *him that* where the ASV substantivizes the noun's article (76.11); לְ and מִן take whatever preposition the ASV wrote; יָרֵא is a finite verb in 76.8 and a Niphal participle predicate in 76.7 and 76.12, and the two participle predicates divide alike — the copula on the participle, the explicit אַתָּה keeping only *thou* in 76.7, and the supplied *He* of 76.12 marked added under rule 25's finite-inflection sentence, since no nominal in that verse denotes the referent.

The three added units (76.4 *and* with no waw between the predicates, 76.7 appositional *even* with no marker or connective, 76.12 *He*) each answer to no morpheme and are not folded anywhere else in the chapter; the waws the ASV renders postpositively or correlatively are aligned to their words (76.2 *also*, 76.6 *Both* / *and* on the two waws of וְרֶכֶב וָסוּס, per rule 14's each-member-has-its-own-connective sentence).

76.6 נִרְדָּם → *are cast into a dead sleep* (head *dead*) and 76.0 נְגִינֹת → *stringed instruments* (head *stringed*) both follow rule 31's never-written-alone test and name the competing head; 76.7 מֵאָז → *when once* and 76.10 *gird upon thee* name their competing readings under rule 8. Left as accepted.

BSB: 122/122 comparable tokens agree; nothing to adjudicate. The three notes the validator flags as repeating (supplied *the* on a construct, suffix to possessive, supplied *the* on a bare noun) restate rules 29, 18 and 15 and need no convention. No promotion: the chapter applied existing rules and taught nothing the contract lacks.
